Under this Direction, IRCC is expected to ensure, and report on, compliance with the on-site requirement at a departmental level. Achieving departmental compliance requires that all non-exempt employees follow the Direction and contribute to the departmental objective. To support managers, who are often not co-located with their employees, in ensuring the equitable application of
- Prescribed Presence in the Workplace Monitoring Program, Bank Number PPU 084
